skill_name: Write an email to complain about a bad customer service experience.
workflow:
Dear Customer Service Representatives,

I am writing to express my disappointment with the customer service I experienced when attempting to purchase a laptop online. 

I had filled up my cart with the items I wanted and was ready to check out when the system unexpectedly crashed. Unfortunately, I was unable to pay for the items and had to start again from the beginning due to the crash.
